$Comment: The Yeti's fight in the Yeti Cave, a Variant of this pack's Orbis_Boss_Encounter_Template (its
comment tells the whole flow). It runs in Prefabs/Christmas/Christmas_Yeti_Cave.prefab.json, which
tools/arena_markers.py writes from tools/arenas/Christmas_Yeti_Cave.json.
No guard wave: the Yeti rises from Christmas_Yeti_Marker, in front of his den, as soon as a player
comes into the hall, with one health step per player beyond the first (500 each on his 1000).
Phase 1 is his own fighting: the game Yeti's swipes, and a ringed ground slam every third attack
(his role's Root_Christmas_Yeti_Attack). At 60% of his health, phase 2 (Macro_Christmas_Yeti_Phase):
the music moves on, the members are told (Christmas_Yeti_Snowballs), and every 8 seconds a ring
lights under each player and a snowball falls onto it, slowing whoever it lands on
(Root_Christmas_Yeti_Snowball_Volley). At 30%, phase 3, the same macro with two White Wolves
(Christmas_Yeti_Wolf) rising around the fight's entity, the music's last movement, the news
(Christmas_Yeti_Wolves) and a volley every 6 seconds. A health pack drops now and then on the points
the cave's prefab tags Orbis_Boss_Health_Pack, every 70 to 150 seconds. A wipe or a reset clears the
wolves and the Yeti, and Macro_Christmas_Yeti_Reset clears the phases' flags.
The fight's reach. This script stands in the hall, 29 blocks south of the den's back wall and 20
north of the hall's mouth. ArenaRange 31 (who is in the fight, the wipe and empty-cave checks, the
music) and ScalePlayerRange (the health steps) count a player anywhere in the den or the hall and
nobody at the arrival spot down the passage, 35 away. SummonPlayerRange 21 raises him as a player
steps out of the passage into the hall. CorpseRange 36 finds a fallen player anywhere in the cave,
and the volleys reach every player in the fight (VolleyRange). LeashRange 28 is the fight's call
back for a role that answers it, which the Yeti's does not; his role's own LeashDistance (45)
covers the whole cave, so he never turns home mid-fight.
Move the script's cell in tools/arenas/Christmas_Yeti_Cave.json and these numbers together.
His death pays each credited player Christmas_Yeti_Daily (the first win each day) and
Christmas_Yeti_Chase (the Boss Kill Claim, also the first win each day), both under
Server/Rewards/Christmas; the dungeon pays its clear beside them
(ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/Christmas_Yeti_Cave.json). The binding row
ZiggfreedCommon/Encounters/Christmas_Yeti_Encounter.json names the fight and keeps its records. Tune
a phase in _ForwardedModifiers below (each transition's HealthRange, each phase's Interval and
AddCount), the health packs in HealthPackInterval. This file's name is not a role's: a script named
after a role replaces it.
